ambient: The angle of the slope changes and you do not.
Something enormous passes on the far side of the surface, unhurried.
A very long way off, somebody says something kind, once.
description: A smooth grey slope going down and inward, and you are sliding along the inside of it at a speed that has no urgency in it at all. There is no fear here. There is not much of anything here. Your body is a thing you have been told about by somebody reliable.
name: The Grey Funnel

looks: Featureless, and going past very fast, and you are not moving.
You put a hand to it. The hand is a long way off and takes a while to report back.
It is not grey. There is no word for it and grey is the nearest one available.
objects.name: the slope

looks: A rumour. Well sourced, but a rumour.
It is somewhere behind and above, doing its own admin.
You remember owning one. The memory is fond and getting fonder.
objects.name: your body

weather: There is no weather. There is no air, particularly. Nothing here needs any and neither do you.
